message: 天使とバイクとジェラシック

name: Synn
message: 「Is Azel an angel?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-Whaaat?! Wh-wh-wh-why would you--I mean, wh-wh-wh-what a funny joke you're making, Mr. President?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I knew it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's got wings sticking out, too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「D-Don't just jump to conclusions on your own! W-We are definitely not angels! W-What are you even talking about with wings?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why did she come to this world? Haven't you heard anything?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「U-Umm, well.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like I'm planning to do anything just because she's an angel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that true?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Impressive as always, Synn-sama. Planning to blackmail them with their secret and make them your mistresses!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「H-How wicked of you, Mr. President!」

name: Synn
message: 「I wouldn't do something like that!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So your target is only Azel-san... I'm glad I'm not your type, Mr. President.」

name: Synn
message: 「I just want to ask about Azel's recent behavior, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, you should have said so from the start. Of course, I am not an angel.」

name: Synn
message: 「That doesn't even matter.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san may be a delinquent who barely attends class, gets bad grades, and doesn't try to make friends, but she isn't doing anything bad! I guarantee it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Skipping class is already plenty problematic, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san is an outstanding person who was dispatched from Heaven to investigate the Re-Crea!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And even after the investigation ended, she's an admirable person who volunteered to stay behind alone on the surface to continue observing!」
So that's how it was!

name: Synn
message: 「Someone said they saw Azel at the academy in the middle of the night.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What a wicked deed, despite being an angel! Unforgivable!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Where'd that guarantee go.」

name: Synn
message: 「You have an idea?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're quite clueless too, President-san. What delinquents do at midnight is go around smashing the academy's windows and riding off on stolen motorbikes!」

name: Synn
message: 「I really don't think she's doing anything like that, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We cannot simply stand by and do nothing about this!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As a fellow kin and as a friend, leave it to me to stop any further delinquency! Rumbl-bl-bl-bl-bl!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, where are you going, Lolotte?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel! As a fellow kin and as a friend, we need to talk! Brace yourself and listen!」

name: Eddie
message: 「Who's this kid?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「She's one of Synn's harem members~」

name: Eddie
message: 「You sure have a wide range of tastes, Synn.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's Lolotte, the Student Council secretary! Not part of any harem!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Where's Azel?」

name: Synn
message: 「*Huff, huff* Caught up... Azel didn't come in today.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She might have already ridden off on a stolen motorbike! There's no time to waste!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. How did it go?」

name: Synn
message: 「She wasn't at Prier or the church. Though, I heard something concerning.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What is it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That brat, right? Apparently she bought up a huge stash of Vandine Jelly last Saturday.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could she be planning to hole up in her room?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If only that were the case.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you manage to hear anything from her directly?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I figured she wouldn't let me into her room, so I let myself in with a spare key.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A spare key?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya prepared it for me.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It was empty.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, during fifth period I--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You sure are getting along famously with Lolo-chan.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooh, she exploded right out of the gate~」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course I am. We're fellow members of the Student Council, after all. Anyway, Nanaka--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What were the two of you doing flirting around during lunch break?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-We weren't flirting or anything!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Calling Lolo-chan out in secret, then the two of you sneaking off somewhere together away from prying eyes for the whole lunch break.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, whatever, I don't care. Just keep your improper relationships in moderation, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「We were just looking for Azel!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't need to make up excuses like that. I'm just a childhood friend, after all, so I get that there are things you don't want to tell me.」

name: Synn
message: 「I was planning on telling you about this, Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I already figured it out, so you don't have to go out of your way to tell me. You guys didn't even need to date in secret, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!? Dating? Me and who!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama and the angel, ain't it?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooh! I don't think that's it, though~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, even Synn's got a girlfriend now, huh... Guess I'm getting old too. Ahaha.」

name: Synn
message: 「Agh, enough already! Nanaka, come here for a second!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What's the big idea dragging me all the way out here! I already get that you and Lolo-chan started dating, so drop it already.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not it! Why would you even think that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-Because if it was Student Council business, you could've just talked about it at the Student Council.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, we're comrades so it's not like we're on bad terms, but we're not close enough to hang out one-on-one, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So... I get it already, drop it...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not it! Azel is missing!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not Lolo-chan, it's Azel... So you were into flat chests... I see how it is...」

name: Synn
message: 「You've got it all wrong! Azel went missing! She's not at the church, not at Prier, and not in the dorms!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ehhhhhhh!? Wait, are you serious!? Isn't she just skipping class like usual!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Lolotte apparently asked Riesling-san to look into it, so I think she'll be found soon, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...I-I see... So that's what it was... Aha, ahaha.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I did it again... I'm acting weird... Ever since we kissed...」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, I'm not going out with Azel or Lolotte!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「G-Got it. I got it, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, I'm glad...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to report this to Helena-san, so I think I'll be late for fifth period next.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um, well... Synn, hey, my hand...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My hand, um... let go...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... s-s-sorry!」
Nanaka's hand is so soft and small.
Even though it's gotten calloused here and there from making soba almost every day.
Was it always this small?

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Saying sorry makes you sound weird, Synn... We've held hands plenty of times before, haven't we?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, probably...」
Even though we must have done it so many times we didn't even think about it.
Even though way back when, we used to do it all the time so naturally I don't even remember.
Why is my heart pounding like this?

name: Synn
message: 「...Um, well then, I'm gonna get going.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um, about earlier... I was kind of all over the place...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm sorry!」

name: Misa
message: 「Azel-san is missing, you say!?」

name: Misa
message: 「What were you even doing, Sakura-kun!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't blame everything on Synn!」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, you're in the same class, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「My bad.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It couldn't be helped. I mean, she barely answered even when you talked to her, and she was skipping classes left and right.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lately, she'd vanish right after morning homeroom ended, too.」

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder where she went.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please leave it to me, my butler will find her right away!」
Nanaka's hand. It was so small...
And it made my heart pound...
If just holding her hand got me like that, how hard would my heart pound if I hugged her.

name: Misa
message: 「What could she have been doing at the academy at night, I wonder?」
Wait, not the time for that! I need to focus on Azel right now.
Is there some connection between Melilot-san's actions and Azel's?
And who is Azel's enemy?
Apparently, Azel came to this world to investigate Re-Crea.
Since she's an angel, would her enemy be Demons?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Taking a walk?」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No girl would want to take a walk around a scary place like school at night!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem. Not that I'm scared or anything. I'm just speaking in general terms.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She intends to smash every single windowpane in the academy.」
Could Pasta and the others have been fighting Azel?
Then are Melilot-san, a Demon, and Azel, an angel, enemies?
Is Melilot-san with the enemy? After all, she's one of the Seven Demon Generals, just like Bylous and Soltia.
Still, why did she only drive me away when she could have done whatever she wanted to me?
I don't know. I don't know, yet.
Do all the answers lie at the academy at night?

name: Misa
message: 「I won't let that happen! Crusaders, move out!」

name: Synn & Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We're deploying for our friend! I'll smooth things over with Jiiya.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I was thinking that much myself!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, Sakura-kun, you're hopeless, breaking the Chairwoman's orders like that. Still, you'd be in trouble without me, so I'll join in--both to help and to watch over you.」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan, Synn-kun didn't say anything about moving out.\s02」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun! You embarrassed me because you didn't say the thing you always say!」
That's right. It's what the usual me would have said first thing.
The Student Council President's--no, the usual Synn Sakura's way of doing things.
Why had I forgotten? Why was I trying to do it all alone?

name: Synn
message: 「Misa. Thank you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-What's with you all of a sudden?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. That really is how we always do things.」
Melilot-san called me arrogant for patrolling all by myself.
She was right--I was arrogant. I'd lost my way in a weird spiral.

name: Synn
message: 「Then, to search for Azel--Crusaders, sortie!」

name: Synn
message: 「However, anyone busy with Holy Night Festival preparations doesn't have to participate.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Of course I'm participating!」
Nanaka is a member of the Crusaders, not someone for me to protect.
She's a comrade who fights alongside me.

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, even though you're busy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's not like that, it's just an emergency like this means I gotta prioritize it...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's no way I could sit out... all by myself.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer-san. You're planning to use patrol as an excuse to skip your assignments, aren't you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I am not!」
